Package org.apache.juneau.http.response

Class UnprocessableEntity.Unmodifiable

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.apache.juneau.http.response.BasicHttpException
org.apache.juneau.http.response.UnprocessableEntity
org.apache.juneau.http.response.UnprocessableEntity.Unmodifiable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, HttpResponseMessage, UnmodifiableBean
Enclosing class:
UnprocessableEntity
public static class UnprocessableEntity.Unmodifiable extends UnprocessableEntity implements UnmodifiableBean
Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing UnprocessableEntity exception.

Its only behavioral override is modify(Runnable), which throws — because all mutation is funneled through modify(...), this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.

  • Method Details

    • modify

      protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation)
      Description copied from class: BasicHttpException
      Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.

      Every fluent setter routes through this method. The nested Unmodifiable snapshot overrides only this method to throw, which freezes the entire mutation surface with a single override. Because this is a Throwable-rooted hierarchy (no CRTP self-type), the funnel returns the base type.

      Overrides:

      Parameters:
      mutation - The state change to apply.
